# Awards Central

Welcome to Awards Central, Scouting America’s repository for information about
official awards and recognitions. This is where the most up-to-date
information about BSA-related awards may be found, including award
applications and nomination forms.

Those interested in proposing a new award should complete an [Award Proposal
Application](https://filestore.scouting.org/filestore/pdf/512-506_WEB.pdf),
which includes details about the proposal and approval process.

[Click here](/resources/info-center/insignia-guide) for an online version of
the _Guide to Awards and Insignia,_ No. 614937. This resource is available for
purchase from [ScoutShop.org](https://www.scoutshop.org/bsa-2019-guide-to-
awards-and-insignia-648215.html) or through your [local Scout
Shop](https://www.scoutshop.org/storelocator).
